| 1 | `wrk_38168c6abeb59e5b` | An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale | Alexey Dosovitskiy; Lucas Beyer; Alexander Kolesnikov | 2020 | ICLR 2021 | OA | — |

abstract.teaser: While the Transformer architecture has become the de-facto standard for natural language processing tasks, its applications to computer vision remain limited. We show that a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches can perform very well on image classification tasks.

bibliographic.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
